risks.description: Local, replay, and disposable-lab evidence can be mistaken for live environment proof if public language is not bounded.
risks.mitigation: Keep every public claim tied to limitations, evidence references, review status, and withdrawal paths.
risks.residual_risk: Readers may still overgeneralize beta evidence outside the documented scope.
risks.stop_or_rollback_condition: Withdraw beta language if limitations are removed, contradicted, or hidden.

risks.description: Future upstream evidence may change after review.
risks.mitigation: Bind independent review to exact P123-P129 release evidence hashes and fail closed on drift.
risks.residual_risk: A stale public page could remain visible after local gate failure.
risks.stop_or_rollback_condition: Unpublish promoted beta materials when any upstream hash no longer matches review evidence.
